drums.tags: Ambient electronic track with a focus on evolving textures and rhythmic synthesis. A deep, resonant sub-bass provides a steady low-end presence while a mid-range synth pad with a slow attack and long release creates a shifting harmonic bed. A high-frequency, percussive synth sequence with a short decay and heavy delay effect runs throughout, creating a sense of constant motion. Granular synthesis textures and filtered noise sweeps enter and exit the arrangement. The track features a steady 120 BPM tempo in 4/4 time, likely in the key of C minor. Reverb is applied generously to the higher-frequency elements to create a wide stereo image, while the low-end remains centered and dry.

bass.tags: Synthwave with heavy outrun and retrowave influences. A gated reverb snare hits on beats 2 and 4, while a sidechained analog synth bass pulses in sixteenth-note triplets. The lead melody is played on a detuned sawtooth synthesizer with a short portamento and heavy delay. Arpeggiated square-wave synths run through a high-pass filter that opens gradually. A digital drum machine provides a steady kick on every beat. Key of C minor. 115 BPM. 4/4 time signature.
